description:
Get the verification requirement

Returns what the regulator demands before this number can carry traffic. When the number needs no verification the response is `{ "kycRequired": false, "requirement": null }`. Otherwise `requirement` describes the accepted identity kinds, how many documents of which type are needed, which fields are mandatory and which forms must be signed. Read this first: it tells you exactly what to put in the submission body.
name: get_phone_number_verification
title: Get the verification requirement
